headline: Google, Meta and TikTok sue California over teen social media law
summary: Google, Meta and TikTok are suing to block a California law, Assembly Bill 1709, that would require platforms to remove psychologically exploitative features and, if it takes effect next year, restrict social media access for children under 16.

claims.statement: Google, Meta and TikTok are suing to block a California social media law aimed at protecting kids.

sources.quote: Google, Meta and TikTok are all suing California to block social media law intended to help kids
